title: Mobile Network Dead Zones in MRT Network and Steps to Rectify Persistent Signal Gaps
what_it_is: Mobile Network Dead Zones in MRT Network and Steps to Rectify Persistent Signal Gaps

sections.label: MNO 4G MRT coverage standards
sections.summary: MNOs must meet IMDA 4G Quality of Service standards, including over 99% mobile coverage in MRT tunnels and stations, with results published online.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Mobile Network Operators (MNOs) are required to meet the Infocomm Media Development Authority’s (IMDA's) 4G Quality of Service standards, and IMDA conducts regular checks to ensure these are met.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: This includes the requirement to provide more than 99% mobile coverage in all Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) tunnels and MRT stations in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: The Quality of Service performance results for each MRT line are published on IMDA’s website.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: MNOs typically take six months to complete these enhancements, working within the limited hours of maintenance windows for tunnel access.

sections.label: No persistent MRT signal gaps
sections.summary: Over the last three years, no persistent signal gaps within the MRT network remained unrectified.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
